messages.subject: Running Measurement Invariance Model
parts:
Hi everyone,
I'm running a measurement invariance model using Lavaan. The syntax below is what I have used.
MI <- cfa(model = Model1, data = Child, meanstructure = T, group = "AgeGroup_C", missing = "listwise")

However, I getting an error below. How can I delete missing values and how do I make sure that the model estimates. Kindly help

Error in crossprod(Diff, Sigma.inv) : non-conformable arguments
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In lav_data_full(data = data, group = group, cluster = cluster,  :
  lavaan WARNING: group variable ‘AgeGroup_C’ contains missing values

2: In lavaan::lavaan(model = Model1, data = Child, group = "AgeGroup_C",  :
  lavaan WARNING:
    Model estimation FAILED! Returning starting values.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Running Measurement Invariance Model
parts: How can I delete missing values
You don't have to, lavaan does it for you.  That's what missing="listwise" means (and it is the default, so no need to explicitly set it).
how do I make sure that the model estimates

Does the second warning have anything to do with the first?  Can you show us

table(Child$AgeGroup_C)
